conventions.convention: The grid is the unit periodic torus, d ≥ 1, N ≥ 2, h = 1/N, with cell-centred pressures, right-face-centred velocity components, and indices reduced modulo N. Pressure arrays in Q_h have zero discrete mean; mass pairings have weight h^d.

G_h is the forward cell-to-face difference, D_h the backward face-to-cell divergence, Δ_h = D_hG_h is negative semidefinite, and A_h is the negative componentwise velocity Laplacian. D_h and G_h are negative mass adjoints.

The real saddle matrix is K = [A Bᵀ; B 0], with A SPD and B full row rank. S = BA⁻¹Bᵀ is positive; the trailing block-LU Schur complement is −S. Symmetric preconditioning uses C⁻¹KC⁻ᵀ when Pγ = CCᵀ = diag(A, γM_Q).

Backward Euler requires ν,k > 0, divergence-free input velocity, mean-zero pressure, and componentwise discrete mean-zero force. Its increment equation is Δ_hφ = k⁻¹D_hũ, velocity update u = ũ − kG_hφ, and pressure update p_new = p_old + φ.

BDF2 starts at n ≥ 1 with caller-supplied u⁰,u¹,p¹. Its correction coefficient is 2k/3; the rotational pressure branch subtracts νD_hũ. No initialization accuracy, stability, or convergence rate is asserted.

The MINI corollaries assume Countable Choice, dimensions two or three, bounded connected Lipschitz polygonal/polyhedral domains, homogeneous Dirichlet velocity, and finite nonempty conforming shape-regular affine simplicial meshes. The viscosity form is 2ν∫ε(v):ε(w); the spectral scaling is γ = 1/ν and applies to steady stiffness.

load_bearing.statement: Δ_h maps Q_h bijectively to itself, its kernel on all cell arrays consists exactly of constants, D_hv has zero mean for every v ∈ V_h, and every q ∈ Q_h satisfies ‖q‖ ≤ √d ‖G_hq‖.
P_h = I − G_hΔ_h⁻¹D_h is the mass-orthogonal projector onto ker D_h. The backward-Euler correction satisfies uⁿ⁺¹ = P_hũⁿ⁺¹ and D_huⁿ⁺¹ = 0 exactly.
Under the stated positive energy-equivalence, continuity, and inf-sup constants, (β²/Λ)qᵀM_Qq ≤ qᵀBA⁻¹Bᵀq ≤ (C_b²/α)qᵀM_Qq for every q ∈ Q.

For periodic u ∈ C⁴ and p ∈ C³, staggered divergence, velocity Laplacian, and pressure-gradient sampling errors are uniformly O(h²). Zero-integral C² scalar fields have O(h²) discrete midpoint mean on cell-centred or face-centred samples.
The normalized Schur eigenvalues μ_j lie in [β²/(Λγ), C_b²/(αγ)]. The symmetric preconditioned saddle eigenvalues are (1 ± √(1+4μ_j))/2, together with 1 of multiplicity n−m.
Under its Countable Choice, domain, mesh, and MINI hypotheses, ((C_F C_div(D))⁻²/(ν(1+d)))M_Q ⪯ S_h ⪯ (d/ν)M_Q for the steady viscous velocity stiffness.

Every admissible backward-Euler or BDF2 step has a unique predictor, unique mean-zero pressure increment, and unique updated pair. Both algorithms preserve the zero-mean pressure gauge and exact discrete incompressibility.

seams_checked.note: Checked both page interfaces. The supplier treats bounded-domain no-slip MINI Navier–Stokes with zero-mean pressure and viscosity form 2ν(ε(u),ε(v)); the consumer preserves those conventions in its steady MINI corollaries. Its periodic staggered-grid Stokes results are proved independently. Neither page transfers periodic projection identities to walls or imports the supplier's refuted instantaneous-pressure claims.
